data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gabbulos', meaning a shield bearer, protector, or defender. In the New Testament, the name Gable is not directly mentioned. The name Gable carries the meaning “Shield bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gable usually hope their child will grow to embody shield bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Gabrielis
in_latin.long_meaning: A name derived from the Latin word 'Gabrielis', meaning 'God is my strength'. It is a common name in the Latin world, particularly due to the biblical figure of the archangel Gabriel.

in_english.name: Gable
in_english.long_meaning: A name of English origin, derived from the Old English word 'gabl' or 'gabell' meaning 'hill' or 'mountain'. It may also be derived from the Middle English word 'gable' meaning 'watchman' or 'guardian'.

data.cultural_impact: The last name Gable has never held a significant reach or presence within the popular Christian names. The name was much more common during the medieval period, when the role of shield bearers and protectors was extensive. Today, the name has been all but forgotten, but its historical significance and meaning continue to inspire those who bear it.
data.spiritual_significance: As a name rooted in protection and defense, the name Gable carries a profound spiritual significance for Christians. It is a reminder of God's constant presence and protection throughout our lives. Like a mighty fortress or a steadfast shield, God defends us from every danger, both physical and spiritual. The name Gable invites us to reflect on God's faithfulness and goodness, and to trust in His loving providence. In a world where countless dangers and challenges lie in wait, the name Gable serves as a powerful reminder of the peace and security that comes from knowing God.
